nodes.name: user_cars.dart
nodes.summary: Riverpod-driven widget that renders the horizontally scrolling 'My Cars' carousel on the home screen, showing skeleton loaders, an empty/login prompt, error text, or a row of car cards depending on auth and fetch state.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ConsumerWidget with ref.listen/ref.watch (Riverpod) to react to auth state changes and re-fetch user cars on login; private StatelessWidget helpers (_CarSkeleton, _EmptyCars) implement loading/empty UI states.

nodes.name: UserCars
nodes.summary: ConsumerWidget that watches auth and user-cars view-model state to decide whether to show a login prompt, skeleton loaders, an error message, or the scrollable list of the user's cars.

nodes.name: _CarSkeleton
nodes.summary: Stateless placeholder card used while user cars are loading, drawing a gray skeleton silhouette of a car card.

nodes.name: _EmptyCars
nodes.summary: Stateless widget shown when an authenticated user has no registered cars, displaying an icon and localized 'no cars found' message.

nodes.name: EmptyCarsCard
nodes.summary: Public stateless card prompting unauthenticated users to log in before they can view their cars, with an icon, message, and a login call-to-action button.

nodes.name: user_cars_provider.dart
nodes.summary: Riverpod dependency-injection wiring for the user-cars feature: declares providers for the remote data source, repository, use cases (get manufacturers, get car brands, get/add/update user cars), and their corresponding view models.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure provider declarations (no functions/classes of its own) composing the feature's data source, repository, use-case, and view-model layers via Riverpod Provider/StateNotifierProvider.autoDispose.

nodes.name: messages_all.dart
nodes.summary: Auto-generated intl message loader that resolves a locale name to its compiled message library and registers the composite message lookup used at app startup.
nodes.languageNotes: Generated by package:intl/generate_localized.dart; should not be hand-edited.

nodes.name: initializeMessages
nodes.summary: Loads and registers the message library for a given locale name, returning a future that completes once messages are available for lookup.

nodes.name: messages_ar.dart
nodes.summary: Auto-generated Arabic message lookup table mapping translation keys (and parameterized message functions m0-m8) to localized Arabic strings for the app's UI.
nodes.languageNotes: Generated by package:intl; MessageLookup class with simpleMessage lookups and m0-m8 ICU-style parameterized message functions.

nodes.name: MessageLookup
nodes.summary: Generated lookup class implementing the Arabic locale's message table, exposing localeName and parameterized message functions (m0-m8) for runtime string interpolation.

nodes.name: messages_en.dart
nodes.summary: Auto-generated English message lookup table mapping translation keys (and parameterized message functions m0-m8) to localized English strings for the app's UI.
nodes.languageNotes: Generated by package:intl; MessageLookup class with simpleMessage lookups and m0-m8 ICU-style parameterized message functions, mirroring messages_ar.dart structure.

nodes.name: MessageLookup
nodes.summary: Generated lookup class implementing the English locale's message table, exposing localeName and parameterized message functions (m0-m8) for runtime string interpolation.

nodes.name: l10n.dart
nodes.summary: Auto-generated localization facade (class S) exposing a getter per translation key declared in the .arb files, used throughout the app as the typed entry point for localized strings (commonly accessed via an 'appLang' helper).
nodes.languageNotes: Generated by the Flutter intl tooling from lib/l10n/intl_en.arb and lib/l10n/intl_ar.arb; contains ~240 generated getters/methods, one per localized string key, plus the LocalizationsDelegate (S.delegate) wired into MaterialApp in main.dart.

nodes.name: intl_ar.arb
nodes.summary: Application Resource Bundle defining all Arabic translation strings and metadata used to generate lib/generated/l10n.dart and messages_ar.dart.

nodes.name: intl_en.arb
nodes.summary: Application Resource Bundle defining all English translation strings and metadata used to generate lib/generated/l10n.dart and messages_en.dart; serves as the template locale (@@locale) for the project's i18n tooling.

nodes.name: coupon_header_data_model.dart
nodes.summary: Legacy data model aggregating a list of coupon header entries plus a status info block, parsed from a JSON API response.

nodes.name: CouponHeaderDataModel
nodes.summary: Holds a parsed list of CouponHeaderModel coupons plus a StatusInfoModel, constructed via a fromJson factory that defensively defaults missing fields.

nodes.name: coupon_header_model.dart
nodes.summary: Legacy data model representing a single coupon header (transaction info, validity dates, discount rate, counts, and related links) with JSON deserialization.

nodes.name: CouponHeaderModel
nodes.summary: Immutable coupon header record (transaction number, company, dates, discount rate, coupon counts, links) built from a JSON map with safe type coercion and date parsing.

nodes.name: status_info_model.dart
nodes.summary: Tiny legacy data model carrying a status code and message returned alongside coupon data from the legacy API.

nodes.name: StatusInfoModel
nodes.summary: Simple status/message pair parsed from JSON, used to convey legacy API call outcomes.

nodes.name: main.dart
nodes.summary: Application entry point that initializes Firebase, the technician location service, and shared preferences, then launches the Riverpod-wrapped MyApp widget which configures MaterialApp's theme, localization delegates, routing, and the global navigator key.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines the top-level navigatorKey GlobalKey used app-wide for navigation without BuildContext, and wires push notification initialization via a post-frame callback in MyApp's State.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Bootstraps the Flutter app: ensures widget binding, initializes Firebase, the technician location service, and shared preferences, then runs MyApp inside a ProviderScope.

nodes.name: MyApp
nodes.summary: Root ConsumerStatefulWidget for the application; its state builds the MaterialApp with theme, locale, localization delegates, navigator key, initial route, and route generator.

nodes.name: _MyAppState
nodes.summary: State for MyApp; initializes push notifications after the first frame and builds the MaterialApp configured with the current locale, theme, localization delegates, navigator key, and onGenerateRoute hook, wrapping content in TechnicianTrackingCoordinator.

nodes.name: route_generator.dart
nodes.summary: Central named-route generator mapping route-name strings to MaterialPageRoute builders for all major screens (splash, onboarding, login, home, car details, promotions, coupons, profile, bookings, chat, appointments), with a fallback error route.

nodes.name: RouteGenerator
nodes.summary: Static utility class implementing onGenerateRoute logic used by MaterialApp; dispatches on route name to build each screen's MaterialPageRoute, passing typed arguments (e.g. CarEntity, UpcomingServiceEntity) where required, and falls back to an error screen for unknown routes.

nodes.name: generateRoute
nodes.summary: Switches on RouteSettings.name to construct and return the matching screen's MaterialPageRoute, forwarding settings.arguments to screens that need typed parameters; returns an error route for unmatched names.

nodes.name: _errorRoute
nodes.summary: Builds a fallback MaterialPageRoute showing a simple error Scaffold when navigation hits an unrecognized or default route name.

nodes.name: widget_test.dart
nodes.summary: Default Flutter-generated smoke test that pumps MyApp and asserts a counter increments from 0 to 1 on tap; appears to be boilerplate left over from the starter template rather than a test tailored to this app's actual features.
